Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment compares two different populations of extracellular vesicles (Small EVs vs Large EVs) isolated by size/density from the same cell line. This is a comparative study of biological fractions rather than a perturbation/treatment experiment, thus it is mapped as un-classified.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The study explicitly uses iTRAQ (isobaric tag for relative and absolute quantitation) with a Q Exactive mass spectrometer in data-dependent mode.

special_reagent_hints: iTRAQ labeling of lysines and peptide N-termini

workflow: we used isobaric tag for relative and absolute quantitation (iTRAQ)-liquid chromatography (LC) tandem mass spectrometry (MS)
The Q Exactive was operated in the data-dependent mode acquiring HCD MS/MS scans
differential: The median log2 iTRAQ protein ratios were calculated over all peptides identified for each protein
Requiring a minimum fold change of 4 and a maximum adjusted p value of 0.01
comparison of protein compositions of exosome-enriched SEVs and MV-enriched LEVs
search_parameters: fixed modifications including MMTS alkylation of cysteines and iTRAQ labeling of lysines and peptide N-termini
Oxidation of methionine was allowed as a variable modification
trypsin enzyme specificity with a maximum of three missed cleavages

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment compares two distinct populations of extracellular vesicles (SEVs vs LEVs) using a 2-plex iTRAQ design across three biological replicates.

acquisition: The Q Exactive was operated in the data-dependent mode acquiring HCD MS/MS scans
labeling: peptides were labeled with iTRAQ reagents according to the manufacturer’s instructions (SCIEX)
quantification: The peptide sequences and relative quantity of peptides was determined by comparing the intensities of reporter ion signals in the MS/MS scan
specialized: EVs were isolated via serial centrifugation
A low-speed pellet was collected at a 10,000 × g spin for 30 min, which contains the LEVs
A pellet of ultracentrifuged SEVs was collected after a 100,000 × g spin overnight

MStype_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on the protein cargo of extracellular vesicles (EVs) separated by size (SEVs vs LEVs). While the study identifies enrichment of adhesion proteins, this is a biological result of the EV isolation, not a PTM-specific chemical enrichment (like phospho or glyco) that would trigger a Stage 4 modifier. The workflow is a standard iTRAQ-based DDA bottom-up proteomics run.
